raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.6.14"
  # dependency versions
  swig_version: 3.0.7
  ldas_tools_cmake_version: 1.5.0
  ldas_tools_al_swig_version: 2.6.14
  ldas_tools_ldasgen_version: 2.7.7

recipe:
  name: ldas-tools-ldasgen-swig
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://software.igwn.org/sources/source/ldas-tools-ldasgen-swig-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a427187196c822e996589de05b96c913ae5b6a6d29abc0df4a5657d8ba8cc154

build:
  number: 1
  skip:
    - win

outputs:
  - package:
      name: ldas-tools-ldasgen-swig
    build:
      script: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake >=3.12,<4.0.0a0
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - swig >=${{ swig_version }}
      host:
        - ldas-tools-cmake >=${{ ldas_tools_cmake_version }}
        - ldas-tools-ldasgen >=${{ ldas_tools_ldasgen_version }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - genericAPI/LDASlogging.i

  - package:
      name: python-ldas-tools-ldasgen
    build:
      script:
        file: build-python.sh
      skip:
        - python_impl != 'cpython'
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/LDAStools/**/*LDASlogging*
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake >=3.12,<4.0.0a0
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - swig >=${{ swig_version }}
        # cross-compile helpers: give the build host a runnable python that
        # reports target-platform metadata so find_package(PythonInterp)
        # succeeds (avoids 'Cannot run the interpreter $PREFIX/bin/python').
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('ldas-tools-ldasgen-swig', exact=True) }}
        - ldas-tools-cmake >=${{ ldas_tools_cmake_version }}
        - ldas-tools-ldasgen >=${{ ldas_tools_ldasgen_version }}
        - libpython
        - python
      run:
        #- ldas-tools-ldasgen >={{ ldas_tools_ldasgen_version }}
        - python
        - python-ldas-tools-al >=${{ ldas_tools_al_swig_version }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - ldas-tools-ldasgen
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - LDAStools.LDASlogging
    about:
      summary: Python bindings for the LDAS Tools generic library

about:
  summary: SWIG interface for the LDAS Tools generic library
  homepage: https://wiki.ligo.org/Computing/LDASTools
  repository: https://git.ligo.org/computing/ldastools/LDAS_Tools.git
  documentation: https://computing.docs.ligo.org/ldastools/LDAS_Tools/ldas-tools-ldasgen/
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: COPYING

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - duncanmmacleod
    - emaros
